local_mode.note: Konkoli-Cremer adiabatic local mode (compliance) of the N1-H1A bond

scan_curvature.note: cubic fit E0 + k/2 x^2 + c x^3 through the two scan points above d0; compare with the local-mode k_a

one_d_model.interpolation: PCHIP slopes (zero at unconstrained minima), cubic Hermite; harmonic walls outside the scanned range
one_d_model.wall_k_source: k_a of the N1-H1A local mode
one_d_model.dvr: Colbert-Miller sinc DVR, 801 points, range scanned +/- 0.6 A

verdict: Barrier 0.72 kcal/mol (cubic-spline estimate 0.75; O-side minimum -0.54) vs harmonic N-H ZPE (normal mode) 3.13 kcal/mol (ratio ZPE/barrier 4.33); 1-D ground level 0.66 kcal/mol (below the barrier top), P(O side) = 0.838.
approximations: 1-D: d(N1-H1A) is the only quantum coordinate; all others follow the relaxed scan (adiabatic); the ZPE of the other 3N-7 modes (notably the H1A bends) is not followed along the path; no multidimensional tunnelling.
Effective mass 0.940 u (N-H reduced mass); heavy-atom relaxation adds inertia that is ignored (upper bound on ZPE and delocalisation).
Harmonic ZPE (1/2 h nu) of the normal mode with the largest N1-H1A stretch character; no anharmonicity.
Electronic energies from the relaxed scan (lower envelope of both chains, 0.10 A grid); equilibrium IEF-PCM at every point; B3LYP-D3(BJ) tends to underestimate proton-transfer barriers.
